'''R5-P8''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. It served as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It had a [[Weequay blaster pistol/Legends|Weequay blaster pistol]] fixed on its head, so it could serve both repair's and security purposes.

==History==
R5-P8 served as a guard in [[Hondo's complex/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's pirate outpost]] during the capture of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. During the attempted escape of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], '''R5-P8''' swiveled his mounted blaster toward the fugitives, but did not manage to fire a shot.{{Droid-stub}}
